[Baby's Diary: My Home]
My mom's cooking is really bad.
Last night, Dad finally couldn't help but complain, “Even Oscar wouldn't eat the food you make”!
Oscar is our dog.
Mom got really mad and asked, “If it's so bad, how come you ate it all?”
I said, “Because Dad is even worse than a dog!”
Um~~ Can someone tell me what the domestic abuse hotline number is?
.......…
my-sss-rank-gluttony-talent-i-can-evolve:
In humanity’s final war against the Demon Lord, the strongest heroes fell—not by the enemy’s hand, but by their own, twisted into madness by a cruel illusion. Betrayal. Bloodshed. Despair… and then, silence.
Only one person remained: Riley—the weakest warrior of them all. Powerless. Ignored. Forgotten.
But he saw through the Demon Lord’s deception. The tyrant was on the brink of death—so weak even a fly could’ve finished him off.
And Riley did just that, drawing every last ounce of strength to bite off the demon’s head.
Victory? Not quite. A final, desperate strike from the Demon Lord pierced him from behind, killing him instantly.
But fate wasn’t done with him yet.
Riley awoke ten years in the past—when the online game [Apocalypse] was launched. Before demons descended. Before monsters overran the world.
And this time, he wasn’t starting from nothing. He had a decade of experience—and a second chance.
Even more shocking, he didn’t awaken his old D-rank Strength Boost talent. This time, he received something far more terrifying: an SSS-Rank Gluttony talent!
He could now devour anything—monsters, items, talents, even traits—and gain their power.…
poison-gods-heritage:
“There is a thin line between poison and medicine, and I shall make you dance on it!”
Dead and reincarnated, Shen Bao finds himself in a world of cultivation, a world he only believed that existed in stories and books.
With hopes of heights and abilities far than what the mortal man could ever dream of, he's given a new purpose in life, however, fate had other surprises in store for him.
What should have commenced as a regular life in any reincarnation story, for Shen Bao everything turned upside down when he found out that he doesn't have the ability to cultivate...
raising-the-forgotten-snake-goddess-with:
“You will die by the fangs of a serpent.”
Instead of fearing snakes, Aiden became fascinated by them. While his family kept him away from every serpent they could find, he buried himself in ancient myths and forgotten legends, eventually becoming captivated by the tale of a nameless snake goddess whose faith had long vanished from history.
When the prophecy is finally fulfilled, death isn't the end.
Aiden awakens in the ruins of an ancient temple, where the forgotten goddess he had admired for years stands on the brink of extinction. With her final fragment of divinity, she binds his life to hers, and the Divine Faith System awakens.
Together, they must rebuild her temples, gather believers, reclaim her lost authority, and raise the forgotten goddess back to the throne she once ruled.
For Aiden, who had dreamed of meeting her all his life, there couldn't have been a greater blessing.
For the goddess...
The lonely deity who had lost everything had finally found her very first believer refuses to let him go.
As her faith returns, so does her divinity.
As her divinity grows, so does her obsession.
To the world, Aiden is the last believer of a forgotten goddess.
To her...
He is hers.…
rebirth-of-the-phoenix:
The Phoenix Clan was once unmatched in power, revered and feared across the world. But when the greed of four great empires united, the clan was destroyed, forcing its survivors into hiding, saved only by the Phoenix’s final sacrifice. Its essence passed to an unborn child, Luis.
Raised in a quiet village, Luis knows nothing of his heritage or the power hidden within him. As he trains to master his aura, mysterious signs begin to surface, hinting at the truth of his lineage. With enemies closing in, Luis must uncover the Phoenix’s legacy and embrace the power he never asked for.
Their are 2 main power systems
Aura: can be progressed through training, every human is capable of growing their aura stronger.
Blessings: are powers given by creatures that rely on aura to be used and controlled. Blessings can only be obtained through mutual consent between creatures and humans. They can be passed through generations but their power diminished over generations.
rebirth-transcending-all-beings:
“I wish to transcend even you, God. To reach a place even you couldn't reach!”
“So let me take your place.”
Growing up in poverty, Vergil never expected his life to amount to anything.
After his organs are harvested and his life ends in silence, he is offered an impossible second chance by a deity known as Weaver.
Granted a powerful Authority and reborn into a world where strength rules, Vergil knows only one thing: move forward with strength.
What Weaver does not tell him is that his Authority carries a side effect. One that will shape not only his fate, but the heavens themselves.
“Wait for me everyone. I'll devour everything and meet you there.”
Warning: This novel contains excessive violence, torture and suicide.
Extra tags #Conquer #Gods #InfinitePotential
reborn-revenge-of-the-concubines-daughte: Living as a concubine’s daughter in her previous life, He Danggui got herself and her daughter tortured and killed by her family and Princess Zhou, while her husband, Lord Ning, allowed them to do so for a secret. After reborn as a child, she swore to hold back her kindness to the villains. How did she survive in a family with various secrets and conspiracies? Who would be her final choice? The love of her previous life or a new lover who could offer her a happy and simple life? Sharing the identities of doctor, political counselor and princess, was she able to bring great changes both in Jianghu and the imperial family? With her intelligence and excellent medical skills, would she let them pay for what they did to her or live differently as a new one?
sickly-cannon-fodder-spoiled-by-the-powe:
Suzy Kale had a weird dream.
In the dream, extreme heat, torrential rain, polar cold, earthquakes, zombies… countless natural disasters struck one after another.
And she was the dream's sickly cannon-fodder female supporting character.
She maliciously framed the female lead, even deliberately tried to seduce the heroine’s harem members, and in the end, met a miserable death.
When she woke up, Suzy realized she was now three months before the apocalypse.
This time, she was determined to change her fate!
She awakened her spatial ability ahead of time, hoarded billions’ worth of supplies, and built a secure safehouse…
Only to inexplicably become bound to a system called the “Handsome Men Collection Guide.”
[Bind a qualifying target, and you get rewards.]
[Even getting close can make you stronger.]
Isn’t this basically forcing her to become a heartbreaker in the apocalypse?!
A cheerful, sunny mixed-race underclassman? She accepts him.
An androgynous beauty of a professor? She accepts him.
A cold-faced, ruthless mercenary? She accepts him, too.…
supreme-sword-exalt:
Framed for his father’s death and cast aside as a traitor, Gu Han is left with nothing but a broken body and a single sword (that is also broken ish)
In a world where strength is everything, showing mercy is a weakness Gu Han cannot afford. What Gu Han wants, Gu Han gets. Black-heartedness is the way. Repay malice with kindness? No, I prefer justice.
Along the way, he crosses paths with all manner of strange characters—arrogant geniuses, eccentric seniors, and fools begging to be slapped back into reality. Bonds were made, tested, and broken.
sword-sovereign-of-the-celestial-emperor:
Celestial Martial Continent, where powerful individuals gather like clouds, and sects are found everywhere.
The anger of a strong individual can burn the heavens and boil the seas, overturn the skies with a wave of their hand, and change the sun and moon with a flick of their finger.
Huaxia Martial Arts Grandmaster Chu Ming, equipped with the Sword God System, unexpectedly arrives in this world. He becomes an outer disciple of the Cyan Yang Sect, possessing extraordinary comprehension, photographic memory, and the ability to traverse the Violet Micro universe, dominate starry rivers, and conquer the myriad realms across heavens.
ten-thousand-dragons-technique:
Lin Xuan had his Spiritual Power absorbed by his ancestral ring for three years, causing his cultivation to regress. He was considered a wastrel and faced endless ridicule.
Later, he received the Great Emperor's inheritance from the ancestral ring, the Extreme Path Ten Thousand Dragons Diagram...
the-ancestor-of-all-demons: The protagonist travels through Shu Mountain and becomes a demonic dragon guarding the heavenly book in Dinghu Peak.
the-dreamers-epilogue:
When the Tower of Self descended, Earth reached its Epilogue.
To survive, earthlings must climb.
Emrys Frost enters the Tower just days after burying his father, forced into a world where power is earned through pain, morality collapses, and death is routine.
But Emrys awakens something wrong.
Something that should not exist.
A Gift.
The Gift of a Dreamer.
Emrys never dreams when he sleeps.
But when he does dream… his dreams are never his own.
So in a Tower where the self is reforged or destroyed, in a world where ancient wars and silent conspiracies never truly end…
Emrys must discover what he is, while surviving long enough to protect the few people he still cares for.
the-extra-of-the-lunerra:
The only game in my life that makes me laugh: The Lands of The Lunerra... I played this game for six thousand hours in three years, and the day I thought I had done everything I could in this game, I felt a great emptiness inside me. I thought nothing in my ordinary and monotonous life could make me happier than when I played this game. But it didn't take long for me to realize that I was wrong with an e-mail I received the night I finished the game.
----
Hi! Thank you to everyone who came to read this story. There are two things I want to tell you.
First of all, I first started writing this about two years ago, but I was writing in my native language, Turkish, and on a different site. But unfortunately, the website where I published the series came to the brink of collapse. While I was thinking about where to publish the series, I remembered Webnovel and here I am. So this is my first English novel and I believe I will make mistakes while translating. Please forgive me for these if you encounter some of them. I will do my best.
Second... yes, while writing this novel I was inspired by most of the novels I've read so far.…
the-fallen-phoenix:
“I will burn the world, that cast me aside!”
Prince Star Crestfold was born to become a legend.
As the firstborn son of King Ikaris Crestfold the fourth, he had everything a prince could ever ask for. Power, status, talent, and a future already written for him.
On the night of his ascension, he was supposed to receive the beastly Vial, and awaken his beast... becoming...
“THE GOLDEN PHOENIX,”
A sacred essence that would mark him as the kingdom's protector and prepare him to lead the legendary (I.V) Illustrious Vanguard.
But the night that was meant to crown his destiny became the night that destroyed it.
A sudden betrayal turns the grand celebration into a nightmare, leaving Star with a power far more terrifying than the Golden Phoenix.
Now, the prince who was meant to become the kingdom's greatest protector has awakened as its greatest threat.
“He was once a pure golden Phoenix, but now....”
the-grand-dukes-son-is-a-heretic:
Betrayed by his sister. Betrayed by chosen one's humanity. Betrayed by the Gods.
That was how the life of Leonard, the Defier of Fate and the world’s greatest heretic, came to an end.
When demons invaded human lands, he received a revelation from the Goddess. She commanded him to act as a spy, to infiltrate the enemy ranks and expose their secrets for humanity’s sake.
To fulfill this mission, he had to sacrifice a part of his soul. He accepted a demonic contract, surrendered his soul, and became a demonic human. Risking everything, he provided critical information to the humans and helped them turn the tide of battle.
But then, he had a shocking discovery.
The war was nothing but a gambit between various gods and before he could act, the war was stopped out of nowhere.
In an unexpected turn, humans and demons put aside their hatred and signed a peace treaty.
Before Leonard could make sense of it, he was betrayed. Both demons and humans joined hands to kill him.
“Fuck! If there is a next life, I swear I will tear you gods apart!”
With this scream, he thought his suffering was finally over.…
the-greatest-disgrace-in-marine-history:
Rogers Darren is a smoker, drinker, liar, lothario, gold-digger, rule-breaker.
At a brutal Marine HQ hearing, Darren faces accusations of scandalous wages, stolen Germa tech, suspicious Celestial Dragon deaths, and a few too many questionable entanglements with nobles-just another day for the greatest disgrace in Marine history.
Biting his cigar, Darren simply grins: “I smoke, I drink, I lust for money and women, I crave power, I lie, and I break every rule... but I'm a damn good Marine.”
Silence fell like a dropped anchor.
(￣□￣；) (ーー゛) (￣o￣)
the-highest-bounty: It is an era of artificial superintelligences, interstellar travel, gene medicine, and virtual reality worlds. Far into Earth’s future, 15-year-old Gu Ding is a student of Cerulean Military Academy by day, and tavern waiter by night. His ambition: Become the space pirate with the highest bounty offered by the Universal Federation Government. With the help of Neptune, a neonate super-intelligence, Gu Ding finds himself thrust into a galaxy of shadowy organizations, political underdealings, and otherworldly forces that lie beyond human comprehension…
the-paladin-in-the-abyss:
This book takes you on a tour of one of the most terrifying yet also most mysterious planes in the Multiverse: the Bottomless Abyss.
------------
A Knight, forsaken by his liege, was forced to exile himself to the Abyss. Due to a fortuitous encounter, he obtained the legacy of a Spiritual Cultivator. What kind of story will he encounter?
------------
The setting mixes the backgrounds of editions 3 and 5, adhering strictly to DND settings apart from the protagonist’s profession, but considers readers who have never participated in a campaign, ensuring that everyone can read it without barriers.
the-princess-kidnapping-system-made-me-o:
Warning!: Blood pumping battles, Gore, dark themes and Comedy that will crack your ribs!
~[System Synchronization Complete!]~
[Listen up Host!]
[Step 1: Get princesses]
[Step 2: Train them to use their abilities]
[Step 3: Receive 10x returns!]
Wise was a regular pawn shop owner, not the extra scammy type, just the regular scammy type.
That was until he was suddenly run over by a derailed train…
The good news? He was reborn.
The catch? He was not the hero, he was not the extra, he was not the knight. No, he was reborn as a legendary Dragon.
A big bad Princess kidnapping Dragon.
The last of the SkyFire bloodline.…
trapped-in-an-omegaverse-tragedy: His sister wrote an omegaverse tragedy to cope with her breakup. But he ended up getting reincarnated into the body of the trash alpha who abused the MC and is destined to be destroyed by the OG male lead. What will Yeon Doha do?
vampire-world-of-blood:
Mercy Morgan was just an ordinary young man trying to make sense of his life, but fate had other plans. One fateful night while on the verge of death, he crossed paths with Michelle Elderblood, an ancient vampire whose bite changed everything. Now transformed into Merciless Minerva Elderblood II, he finds himself thrust into a hidden world of powerful vampires and dark secrets.
In this realm, where myth collides with reality, Merciless quickly realizes he is caught in a dangerous web of many powerful creatures. Meanwhile, the vampires operate under a singular, formidable king, and every encounter reveals the treacherous politics and hidden agendas that dictate their lives. Yet, amid the chaos, a singular purpose ignites within him: revenge.
Merciless barely a day old must face a harrowing exam that plunges him into the depths of forbidden knowledge, forcing him to confront not only the secrets of his new existence but also the gods who have forsaken him.…
wasting-money-to-become-an-immortal:
“You died.”
That was what the mysterious figure told him, but then he was given a second chance for the good deeds that he did in his previous life.
“Super Prodigal System!”
“Cultivate to immortality by wasting as much money as you can!”
For the former number one prodigal of Earth, this was the perfect system!
zenith-of-sorcery:
After years of exile, Marcus is coming back home. A powerful mage with few equals, Marcus lives in a world full of monsters and powerful adepts, many of which have bad histories with him. But he has not come back to pursue vengeance or start a fight. All Marcus wants to do is reconnect with old friends, build himself a house, and maybe train a successor or two.
Alas, the world didn’t stop just because Marcus went into exile, and not everyone is content to let go of old grievances. Strange things are happening in the world at large, too, hinting at a looming disaster of unknown nature. Still, where there is a will, there is a way.
If nothing else, Marcus has a lot of magical power to throw at problems.
+++
Zenith of Sorcery is set in its own original setting and isn’t related to Mother of Learning… beyond being written by the same person, of course. This is a more classical fantasy story than my previous one, with a lower level of technology and stuff like elves and dwarves, but it has a lot of worldbuilding effort put into it and its own complex magical system. The story has significant xianxia influences, but isn’t meant to be a xianxia story.…
